svg.title: Upsize Property Renovation Ltd logo – Social Housing Kitchens, Bathrooms & Roofing, Peterborough
svg.desc: Upsize Property Renovation Ltd: multi-trade property renovation, construction and roofing contractor based in Peterborough. Social housing kitchen and bathroom packages, wet rooms and level-access showers, roofing services (roof repairs, new roofs, flat roofs EPDM and GRP, leadwork and chimney repairs, guttering) for social housing, commercial and residential clients across Peterborough, Cambridgeshire, the East Midlands and South Lincolnshire. Freephone 0800 193 9030. www.upsizeproperty.com
